visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark, styled hair stands in the center of a hazy stage environment. He is wearing a distinctive blue and white denim patchwork jacket. The background features several bright stage spotlights shining downwards through smoke. He gestures with his hands and points towards the camera, addressing the viewer directly with a focused expression. (2) The scene transitions to an overhead view of a city street filled with rows of white Tesla Model 3 cars. The cars are parked tightly together, filling the frame in a repetitive pattern. The lighting is bright, natural daylight. (3) The man reappears on the smoky stage. A stylized cutout image of a female singer appears floating to his right. The man holds up three fingers and speaks expressively. (4) A dense grid of brown bubble tea cups with orange straws fills the screen in a massive, repetitive arrangement stretching toward the background. (5) A montage of 1000 New Taiwan Dollar bills is shown spread across a surface, overlapping each other. (6) A digital interface of a YouTube channel titled 'MIVENUE 綴宇集樂' is displayed, showing the banner, subscriber count, and video list. (7) A woman with short dark hair is seen playing a marimba in a music studio with acoustic foam on the walls and a 'MIVE' logo. (8) Two female musicians perform on a bright stage with a large gong and percussion instruments against a solid blue background. (9) The screen recording shows a finger clicking the 'Subscribe' button on the YouTube channel interface. The man returns to the stage, smiling and extending his hand towards the camera.
